text:
sam: heads up — nightly kernel-sweep reported a ~12% p50 regression on A100 for seq_len=2048 with q4_kernels.
leila: saw that. perfbot attached artifacts: s3://redwood-perf/kernel-sweeps/2026-03-16/A100/q4/ — the microbench shows single-threaded matmul time jump around 1024->2048.
perf-ci-bot: [AUTO] nightly-sweep: kernel-candidates job finished. regressed_kernels: [q4_matmul_v3]. diff: +12.1% p50 latency. artifacts: https://perf.redwood/jobs/1760758400
sam: can someone paste the microbench snippet? quick glance from CI UI was noisy.
leila: paste below — this is the harness command we used:
```
./bench/kernel_micro --model gpt2-like --kernel q4_matmul_v3 --seq 2048 --batch 1 --warmup 5 --iters 50 --device cuda:0 --profile
```
leila: output (trimmed):
```
{ "seq":2048, "batch":1, "median_ms": 11.2, "p50_ms": 11.1, "p95_ms": 19.4, "kernel":"q4_matmul_v3", "backend":"cutlass", "arch":"sm_80" }
{ "seq":1024, "median_ms": 9.8, "p50_ms": 9.7 }
```
leila: for seq<=1024 q4_matmul_v3 is fine, but above that memory writes / staging spikes in our profiler.
dan: we should consider sequence-length routing in the kernel selector. maybe fall back to q4_matmul_v2 for seq>1536 on sm_80.
izzy: +1. Also KV-cache behavior matters: when KV cache is cold the first prompt has different memory pattern. did the harness include realistic KV warmup?
leila: harness includes `--warmup` tokens that run a few forward passes but those are short (len 64). For long-seq kernels we should warm up with a few full-ctx passes.
sam: agreed — add a flag `--kv_warmup_fullctx` to the harness. rerun nightly with that option.
perf-ci-bot: [AUTO] triggered rerun: nightly-sweep-1760759400 with kv_warmup_fullctx=3
leila: quick profiling notes: the hotspots are in fused_gemm_xmma for q4_matmul_v3 when seq>1536. L2 traffic up ~35%. We can try two options: 1) change kernel pick policy to prefer tiled_gemm for long seqs, or 2) autotune launch params (threadblock size) for sm_80 for the v3 kernel.
dan: I'd prefer changing selector first — low-risk. We can A/B rollout to 10% traffic via routing policy and check production telemetry.
izzy: also add microbench variant that measures KV reuse ratio — i.e., run batch with repeated prefixes and compare p50 to cold-run to get cache sensitivity score. name the metric `kv_reuse_sensitivity`.
leila: agreed. I'll add the metric and push harness PR. draft command for the CI job update (circleci-like):
```
jobs:
  kernel-sweep:
    steps:
      - run: ./bench/kernel_micro --matrix "kernel=[q4_matmul_v2,q4_matmul_v3]" --seqs "[256,512,1024,1536,2048]" --kv_warmup_fullctx 3 --report-json artifacts/result.json
```
sam: what about thresholds? current perf CI fails on >5% p50 regression across any arch/seq combo. 12% tripped it.
leila: propose making thresholds per-dim: small-seq stricter (3%), long-seq looser (8%) because long-seq more noisy — but we should flag any persistent +10%.
dan: okay, but ensure the CI posts a per-arch per-seq CSV and the alert groups on persistent regressions over 3 consecutive nights.
perf-ci-bot: [AUTO] new alert rule created: kernel_regression_persistent. triggers when deviance>8% for 3 runs OR >12% for 1 run. notify: #eng-runtime, @sam @leila
leila: I'll open PR with harness changes + autotune harness (grid search for launch params). autotune will output candidate params to s3 prefix and the selector can be fed a JSON mapping.
leila: sample autotune output (conservative):
```
{ "arch":"sm_80", "kernel":"q4_matmul_v3", "seq_range":"<=1024", "params":"tb=128,wx=8" }
{ "arch":"sm_80", "kernel":"q4_matmul_v3", "seq_range":">1024", "params":"tb=256,wx=16" }
```
izzy: note: those larger tb settings increase shared memory and may change L2 behavior — test memory footprint in harness too.
sam: timeline? would like this gated before next dedicated capacity deploy.
leila: I can get a PR by EOD, CI changes + one-night rerun tomorrow. if it looks stable we'll roll selector change to canary next week.
dan: I'll own the selector rollout and routing policy updates.
sam: sweet. thanks. please paste PR link here when opened.
leila: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/542 — contains harness + CI + autotuner scaffolding. comments welcome.
perf-ci-bot: [AUTO] link to artifacts for latest rerun: https://perf.redwood/jobs/1760759400/artifacts
sam: nice. assigning follow-ups: @leila add kv_warmup_fullctx to nightly harness; @dan plan selector canary; @izzy add kv_reuse_sensitivity metric. I'll check the PR later and schedule canary.
leila: will do :thumbsup:
izzy: thanks. I'll start adding bench variants for combined batching heuristics + kv reuse.
sam: end.
